product_updates.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
product_updates.content: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?

product_updates.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
product_updates.content: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

product_updates.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
product_updates.content: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.

product_updates.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
product_updates.content: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

product_updates.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
product_updates.content: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

product_updates.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
product_updates.content: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

product_updates.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
product_updates.content: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

product_updates.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
product_updates.content: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.

product_updates.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
product_updates.content: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.

product_updates.title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
product_updates.content: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.
